item.title: Attachable 1.0.7
item.description:
### Attachable 1.0.7
- Setting up the right-click actions is quicker: the guide opens System Settings for you. - Help › Send Feedback… now fills in what helps us look into a problem: your Attachable and macOS versions, your settings, and the last few jobs (never file names). - A darker wordmark, matching the rest of the family. - The About window and the setup guide always open in front.
